description: Source code for Python tensor type bindings and tensor type management in PyTorch, including type initialization, default type settings, and Python-C++ integration.

classes.name: PyTensorType
classes.description: Represents a Python tensor type with associated properties such as dtype, layout, backend, and scalar type.

methods.name: py_initialize_metaclass
methods.description: Initializes the Python metaclass for tensor types, setting flags, methods, and properties.

methods.name: py_initialize_tensor_type
methods.description: Initializes a specific tensor type in Python with name, type object, and dictionary.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Generates a string name for a tensor type based on backend and scalar type.

methods.name: get_storage_obj
methods.description: Retrieves the storage object for a given backend and data type.

methods.name: set_type
methods.description: Sets the properties of a PyTensorType object based on backend and scalar type.

methods.name: set_name
methods.description: Sets the name of a PyTensorType object.

methods.name: get_tensor_dict
methods.description: Retrieves the tensor class dictionary from the torch module.

methods.name: set_default_storage_type
methods.description: Sets the default storage type in Python for a given backend and data type.

methods.name: set_default_tensor_type
methods.description: Sets the default tensor type in PyTorch based on optional backend and dtype.

methods.name: initialize_aten_types
methods.description: Initializes all declared tensor types, including CUDA types if available.

methods.name: initialize_python_bindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for tensor types, including metaclasses and module registration.

methods.name: py_bind_tensor_types
methods.description: Binds tensor types to the torch module and adds them to the tensor classes set.

methods.name: PyTensorType_Check
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is a PyTensorType.

methods.name: py_set_default_tensor_type
methods.description: Sets the default tensor type in PyTorch from a Python object.

methods.name: py_set_default_dtype
methods.description: Sets the default data type in PyTorch from a Python object.

methods.name: get_default_dispatch_key
methods.description: Returns the default dispatch key based on the current default backend.

methods.name: get_default_device
methods.description: Returns the default device based on the current default backend.
